page.overview:
Who is Litter Bot 573?

Litter Bot #573, known as Obot Unit 573 in the Japanese version, is a character in Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL World Duel Carnival.

をしたおロボット。オボット。ゴミをしてハートランドシティをにすることがのはずだが、のオボットとはったなをっている。よりものをしてし、する。アニメや、ゲームがき。コスプレもきで、があればおをにしてき、にされたカメラでをする。さなぎのなファン。

One of the cleaning robots possessing artificial intelligence that is usually referred to as an Obot.While its given tasks are to collect trash and to keep Heartland City clean, it possesses a unique artificial intelligence that is completely different from that of most other Obots.It instead prioritizes its hobbies and personal interests over work.Loves anime, manga and games.It also likes cosplaying girls, and it uses its cleaning duties as an excuse to go to photo shoots and take pictures with the camera functions it has installed.An ardent fan of Sanagi Chono.
